identification: Mid-century art glass vase and paperweights. Vase is a heavy cased amber-to-green faceted/diamond-cut glass vase (about 20cm) in the sommerso style, with a clear twisted-foot base, Czech (Skrdlovice, Beranek/Zemek style) or Murano origin, no maker mark visible. Photos show THREE paperweights although the title says 2: a clear egg-shaped paperweight with red spiral ribbon, a large clear ball paperweight with pink sphere, bubbles and jellyfish/tentacle shapes over purple, and a small domed multicolour millefiori or confetti paperweight.
